exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean before labor vs. cesarean during labor)
cohort: 160 pregnant women who underwent immediate postplacental IUD insertion
finding: The rates of IUD expulsion were similar in patients who underwent cesarean section before and during labor and who delivered vaginally, with multiparity being the only factor independently associated with IUD expulsion.
mod_finding: The rates of IUD expulsion are similar in patients who underwent cesarean section before and during labor and who delivered vaginally.
